title.narrative: Urgent Support for Water Pumps to Provide Emergency Response to the Drought in Huila Province, Angola

description.narrative: UNOPS supports the procurement of water pumps and accessories equipment in Angola, addressing drought-induced water scarcity and aiming to establish a sustainable water supply by providing equipment, including new pumps, and building capacity. These disaster risk reduction and climate change adaptation efforts enhance community resilience, fostering socio-economic development for a thriving future.
